name: gaming-game-redemption
description: Game-key and entitlement redemption, replay, race, and account-binding behavior.
objectives: Assess redemption authorization, key uniqueness, replay protection, concurrency, entitlement creation, and account binding.
Test abuse chains involving invalid, expired, duplicated, or cross-account test keys and redemption status transitions.
Verify that redemption outcomes remain consistent across API, storefront, and account inventory views.
operational_constraints: Use only synthetic or operator-issued test keys that cannot grant commercial entitlements.
Do not enumerate, redeem, or retain live distribution keys.
